description: Kamchatka regional safety status: active alerts (seismic, volcanic, weather, MChS) with their source and dates, plus elevated volcanoes (KVERT, KB GS RAS). Alert count and severity, when each item appeared and until when it stays, data freshness, source of the top alert (KB GS RAS, GS RAS, USGS, MChS, Roshydromet, NASA FIRMS). KVERT and KB GS RAS are separate scales. Use when asked whether it is safe to go now; for one place use get_guardian_context.
name: safety_status
title: Regional safety status
